description: The words `aidd validate` flags on a Spec's Acceptance line, or a line of its `## Non-functional requirements` section, when the line states no target. A line with a number (list numbering, an Acceptance id such as `A1` or `AC-1`, and a work-item id such as `SPEC-4` do not count), inline code (a test name, a command, or an exact value), a link, or a file path states a target or names the test that proves it, so it never warns. Whole words only, any case: a hyphen joins a word, so `fast-forward` is not `fast`. A warning, never an error, and the gate never reads it. Keep the list short and plain: each entry is a false alarm somewhere.
